rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Home wins or does not win: cumulative winnings
Choose the more likely binary outcome. One unit total per match; draws win the home-not-win bet.
Home-not-win odds are synthesized by splitting the stake between recorded away-win and draw odds.

polyline.style: stroke: rgb(15%,39%,70%); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.6; fill: None; fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(3%,52%,45%); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.6; fill: None; fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(80%,47%,12%); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.6; fill: None; fill-rule: evenodd; stroke-dasharray: 3, 2;
stroke: rgb(58%,32%,69%); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.6; fill: None; fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: rgb(39%,45%,52%); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.6; fill: None; fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Synthetic payout = 1 / (1 / away odds + 1 / draw odds). These are not quoted double-chance prices.
Assumes both component bets can be placed at recorded prices with fractional stakes; excludes fees and rounding.
